units.source_text: 薰中纳言忍受不住了，照例于某日沉静的傍晚到二条院访问。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, could bear it no longer and, as usual, went one quiet evening to visit Nijo Palace.

units.source_text: 二女公子立刻叫人送出坐垫去，并命侍女传言：“今日心绪甚恶，未能晤谈为歉。”

en.t: The second princess at once had a cushion sent out and ordered a lady-in-waiting to say, "I am in very poor spirits today and regret that I cannot meet with you."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听到这话，心中非常悲伤，眼泪即将夺眶而出。

en.t: When Kaoru heard this, he was deeply saddened, and tears were about to spill from his eyes.

units.source_text: 恐被侍女看见了不好意思，便努力忍住，答道：“患病之时，素不相识的僧人都要住在近旁呢。

en.t: Afraid that it would be embarrassing if the waiting women saw him, he struggled to hold back his tears and replied, "When someone is ill, even monks who are complete strangers stay close by.

units.source_text: 就请把我当作医师，许我进入帘内吧。

en.t: Please think of me as a physician and allow me to come inside the curtains.

units.source_text: 如此传言问答，我这访问全无意趣了。”

en.t: If we can only exchange messages like this, my visit has lost all meaning."

units.source_text: 众侍女看见他的神色非常痛苦，想起那天夜间闯入帘内之事，对二女公子说：“如此招待，确是太简慢了。”

en.t: Seeing how painfully distressed he looked, the waiting women remembered how he had forced his way inside the curtains that night and said to the second princess, "To receive him like this is truly too slighting."

units.source_text: 便把正殿的帘子放下，请薰中纳言进入守夜僧人所居的厢屋内。

en.t: They then lowered the curtains of the main hall and invited Kaoru into the side room where the night-watch monks stayed.

units.source_text: 二女公子心中实在非常懊恼。

en.t: The second princess was inwardly extremely vexed.

units.source_text: 但侍女既已如此说了，如果公然表示坚拒，深恐反而教人怀疑，因此只得忧心忡忡地稍稍膝行而前，和客人对晤。

en.t: But since the waiting women had already spoken so, she feared that openly refusing him would only arouse suspicion, and so she had no choice but to creep forward a little on her knees, full of anxiety, and meet her visitor.

units.source_text: 二女公子有时说几句话，然而声音非常轻微。

en.t: The second princess occasionally said a few words, but her voice was very faint.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了，猛然想起大女公子患病初期的样子，觉得不祥。

en.t: Hearing her, Kaoru suddenly recalled how the elder princess had looked at the beginning of her illness and felt a dark foreboding.

units.source_text: 心中一阵悲伤，便觉眼前一片黑暗，一时说不出话来，支吾了好一会。

en.t: A wave of grief came over him, the world seemed to go black before his eyes, and for a time he could not speak, faltering for quite a while.

units.source_text: 他痛恨二女公子坐的地方太进深，便从帘下伸手进去，把那帷屏稍稍推开，照例顺水推舟地挨身进去。

en.t: Resenting how far back the second princess was seated, he reached in beneath the curtain, pushed the screen slightly aside, and, as usual, took the chance to slip in close to her.

units.source_text: 二女公子非常担心，无可奈何，只得召唤她的贴身侍女少将君，对她说道：“我胸中疼痛，你且替我按一下。”

en.t: The second princess was terribly anxious and, helpless to do otherwise, summoned her close attendant Lady Shojo and said to her, "My chest hurts. Press it for me a little."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听见了，说道：“胸中疼痛，按住了越发难过吧。”

en.t: Kaoru heard this and said, "If your chest hurts, pressing on it must make it even worse."

units.source_text: 他叹一口气，坐一坐端正，但心中讨厌这侍女在座，十分焦灼。

en.t: He sighed and sat up a little more formally, but inwardly he disliked having the maid present and felt painfully impatient.

units.source_text: 又对二女公子说道：“你为什么身体常是如此不适呢？

en.t: Then he said again to the second princess, "Why is your health always so poor?

units.source_text: 我曾问过怀孕的人，据说起初确有一个时期身体不适，但不久就会复健。

en.t: I once asked women who had been pregnant, and they said that in the beginning there is indeed a period of discomfort, but before long one recovers.

units.source_text: 你大约是年纪太轻，过分担心之故吧。”

en.t: You are probably still too young and are worrying too much."

units.source_text: 二女公子非常羞愧，答道：“胸痛之病，我是早已有的。

en.t: The second princess was deeply ashamed and replied, "This chest pain is something I have had for a long time.

units.source_text: 亡姐也患此病。

en.t: My late elder sister suffered from the same illness.

units.source_text: 据说患此病者寿命都不长呢。”

en.t: They say that people who have this illness do not live long."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想起世间谁也没有“青松千年寿”，很替二女公子担心，非常可怜她。

en.t: Kaoru remembered that no one in this world enjoys the thousand-year life of a green pine, and he worried deeply for the second princess and pitied her greatly.

units.source_text: 便顾不得少将君在座，把自昔以来对二女公子的爱慕之情一一诉说，但把刺耳难闻的话删去，措词非常文雅，只叫二女公子听了心领神会，而别人听了不觉得异样。

en.t: No longer caring that Lady Shojo was present, he told the second princess, one by one, of the affection he had long felt for her, but he left out any harsh or unpleasant words and spoke with such elegance that only the second princess understood his meaning, while others heard nothing strange.

units.source_text: 少将君听了，觉得此人的好意实在深可感谢。

en.t: Listening to him, Lady Shojo felt that this man's goodwill was truly something to be deeply grateful for.
